station_log._doc: G2b layer C: tonight's station-log lines, verbatim from CANON_INDEX §6 log_1971 (the rows documents.py draws). Written once each, by a duty's "log" or a beat's ["log", id] action; blender/log_strips.py renders each row in Callum's hand.

1971-11-14.text: Batteries flat. Engine started, on charge.
Radio check Stornoway CG. Gale warning, severe gale 9.
Kittiwake (SY 37) brought in by North Sound on radio bearings.
Stornoway CG on Ch. 16. All well.

_doc: THE LAST LIGHT campaign (layout 3: Stage 3B plus the brief of 2026-11-06, ch1 dark arrival; STAGE3_NARRATIVE_MASTER.md §7, §20b). Beats run in order; 'when' is a StoryState expression (flag(), has_flag(), clue(), saved(), lost(), piloting(), lit_by_hand(), relation(), sim.*). 'hint' is [seconds, text(, unless <expr>)] or a list of them (item 36: a hint whose 'unless' is already true is skipped). 'objective' is a string or {title, steps: [{text, done <expr>, live}]} (item 9). Director actions: talk, wait, until <expr>, release <ship> (a holding story ship makes way), objective, set/unset/add/clue, ship, storm, clock, fault (jam [story] | trip | overheat), battery, mode, intensity, autosave, timeskip, ending_card, end_campaign; presentation events for game_fp: hint, sky, phantom_echo, footsteps, knock, door_open, visitor_enter, sfx, static, music, caption. story_test rejects unknown names. 'optional_calls' are radio calls offered in the panel after beat open_after has run and until beat close_at has run; 'needs_power' (brief item 32) marks a beat that can only move on with power (radio or light): while it waits unpowered the director shows what to fix. 'story_voice' lists ships whose 'we have the channel lights' report a story conversation speaks itself (item 26). 'after_read' maps a document to [first chapter, last chapter, conversation] room lines played once each.

duties.caption: The Watch
duties.line: Get the engine running. Then CHARGE the cells.

sub.line: The torch, top shelf by the stair door
sub.nudge: Torch. Top shelf, by the stair door.
sub.hint: The torch is on the top storage shelf by the stair door: look at it and press {interact}.

sub.nudge: She'll not start dry. The FUEL VALVE, in the cage.
sub.hint: In the generator cage: turn the red FUEL VALVE handle ({interact}), then hold {interact} on START.

sub.nudge: The engine first. START, in the cage.
sub.hint: The generator cage stands by the south-west wall. Hold {interact} on the black START button until she catches.

sub.nudge: Now the charge. The lever on the charger.
sub.hint: The CHARGE lever is on the charger cabinet, below the small meter.

duties.caption: Lighting-up time
duties.line: MODE to AUTO, LAMP to NORMAL.

sub.nudge: Lighting-up time. The console, under the east window.
sub.hint: The light console stands under the east window. Look at the MODE knob and press {interact} until it reads AUTO.

sub.nudge: LAMP to NORMAL, beside the MODE knob.
sub.hint: The LAMP knob is beside MODE on the light console: press {interact} to turn it to NORMAL.

duties.caption: Kittiwake
duties.line: Fix Kittiwake's position on the radio.

sub.nudge: The radio. The boy'll want his position checked.
sub.hint: Sit at the radio on the desk (look at it, press {interact}), select Kittiwake and choose Confirm position.

sub.nudge: Give the boy a moment to answer.
sub.hint: Wait at the radio for Kittiwake to report her position on Channel 16.

duties.caption: Kittiwake
duties.line: Bring her in on the 000° line.

sub.line: The hand compass, from the chart
sub.nudge: The hand compass is on the chart. North at a glance.
sub.hint: The brass hand compass lies on the chart, near the left corner: take it with {interact}.

sub.nudge: She's east of the line. Bring her round to port.
sub.hint: On the radar she sits to the right of the dashed 000° line. Order TURN PORT (her left) once or twice, then MAINTAIN when she points down the line. The chart's transcription ({transcript}) explains the terms.

duties.caption: Kittiwake

sub.nudge: The glasses are on the desk. I'd see her better.
sub.hint: The binoculars lie on the desk beside the radar: take them with {interact}.

duties.hint: Kittiwake follows the North Sound line in by herself now. Watch her on the radar.

duties.caption: The log
duties.line: Write up the evening at the desk.

sub.line: The station log, open on the desk
sub.nudge: The log's waiting on the desk.
sub.hint: The logbook lies open on the desk, left of the chart: look at it and press {interact}.

duties.caption: Strange Signals
duties.line: Watch the radar for the caller.
duties.nudge: The radar. Whoever it was, they were close.
duties.hint: The radar screen stands on the desk beside the radio.

duties.caption: Gannet
duties.line: Bring Gannet in by the West Gut.

sub.nudge: Gannet's for the West Gut. Three-one-four.
sub.hint: Confirm Gannet's position, then turn her until she points down the West Gut line on the radar.

sub.nudge: Watch her in.
sub.hint: Keep her on the 314° line until she reaches shelter.

sub.line: The old-log box, top shelf by the stair door
sub.nudge: The old logs. The oak box, top shelf.
sub.hint: The old station logs are in the oak box on the top storage shelf, left of the stair door.

duties.caption: The gear
duties.line: Free the jammed gear by hand.

sub.nudge: Motor off first. MODE to OFF.
sub.hint: At the light console: {turn_back} on the MODE knob turns it back to OFF.

sub.nudge: Back her past the tooth with the handwheel.
sub.hint: With the motor off, {wheel} on the handwheel turns the optic by hand, back past 046°.

sub.nudge: MODE to AUTO. Let the motor take her.
sub.hint: At the light console: MODE back to AUTO ({interact} on the knob).

duties.caption: Two boats
duties.line: Bring both boats in. Mind the battery.
duties.done: (saved("Corrie May") or lost("Corrie May")) and (saved("Lowestoft Star") or lost("Lowestoft Star"))

sub.line: Corrie May into the East Gut, 046°
sub.nudge: Corrie May's for the East Gut.
sub.hint: Corrie May belongs in the East Gut (046°): confirm her position, then turn her onto the line.

sub.line: Lowestoft Star into the North Sound, 000°
sub.nudge: The Lowestoft Star, North Sound. Due north.
sub.hint: Lowestoft Star belongs in the North Sound (000°): confirm her position, then turn her onto the line.

sub.line: MAIN lever up, tall cabinet, west wall
sub.nudge: The red lamp on the cabinet. MAIN.
sub.hint: In the dark: the red MAIN lamp on the tall cabinet. Push the MAIN lever up ({interact}).

optional_calls.label: Call Gannet (Hector, in the West Gut lee)

beats.when: (saved("Corrie May") or lost("Corrie May")) and (saved("Lowestoft Star") or lost("Lowestoft Star"))

duties.caption: The dark boat
duties.line: Get the beam on the dark boat.

sub.nudge: MANUAL. Put the light on her myself.
sub.hint: At the light console: MODE to MANUAL ({interact} on the knob).

sub.line: Hold the beam on her with the handwheel
sub.nudge: The handwheel. Keep the beam on her.
sub.hint: Hold {wheel} on the handwheel until the beam sits on her (the radar shows the beam line).

duties.caption: The dark boat
duties.line: She won't answer. Watch her come in.
duties.nudge: No lights. No answer. Watch her.
duties.hint: The dark boat comes in to the jetty by herself. Watch her on the radar or from the window.

duties.caption: The door
duties.hint: The stair door is on the south wall.

optional_calls.label: Call Stornoway on the MF set (2182 kHz)

do: [A cough, deep in the chest. It goes on a long time.]
[Footsteps on the stair. One step at a time.]

duties.caption: The desk
duties.hint: The bottom-left drawer of the desk.

sub.nudge: MAIN first.
sub.hint: MAIN breaker on the west wall: push the lever up ({interact}).

sub.line: Engine running again (let her cool if she cut out hot)
sub.nudge: The engine. Let her cool if she's hot.
sub.hint: If the generator has cut out hot, let it cool, then hold {interact} on START.

duties.caption: The gear
duties.line: Free the gear by hand. Then MANUAL.

sub.nudge: Motor off. MODE to OFF.
sub.hint: At the light console: {turn_back} on the MODE knob to OFF.

sub.nudge: Back her off the tooth.
sub.hint: {wheel} on the handwheel backs the optic off the tooth, past 046°.

sub.nudge: MANUAL now.
sub.hint: At the light console: MODE to MANUAL ({interact} on the knob).

duties.caption: Iona Star
duties.line: Bring Iona Star through the East Gut.

sub.line: Hold the light on her in MANUAL
sub.nudge: Light her. MANUAL, and hold it.
sub.hint: MANUAL mode puts a long beam on her so she can see: hold it on her with the handwheel.

sub.nudge: Zero-four-six. The East Gut.
sub.hint: Confirm her position, then turn her onto the 046° line.
